columns.name: Active Daily Interest

columns.name: Projected Interest Coverage Date
columns.formula:
=IFS(
  [Total Outstanding Principal] <= 0,
  "",
  [Active Loan Interest Earned] >= [Total Outstanding Principal],
  TODAY(),
  [Active Daily Interest] > 0,
  TODAY()
    + CEILING(
      ( [Total Outstanding Principal] - [Active Loan Interest Earned] )
        / [Active Daily Interest]
    ),
  TRUE,
  ""
)
columns.display: ="วันที่ดอกเบี้ยครอบคลุมเงินต้น / Projected Interest Coverage Date"

columns.name: Daily Collection Status
columns.formula:
=IFS(
  COUNT([Todays Collection Charges]) = 0, "",
  COUNT(
    SELECT(
      Charges[Row ID],
      AND(
        IN([Row ID], [_THISROW].[Todays Collection Charges]),
        [Charge Date] < TODAY(),
        [Payment Status] <> "ชำระแล้ว"
      )
    )
  ) > 0, "Overdue",
  AND(
    NOT(IN("รอชำระ", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status])),
    NOT(IN("ชำระบางส่วน", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status]))
  ), "Fully Paid",
  OR(
    IN("ชำระบางส่วน", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status]),
    AND(
      IN("ชำระแล้ว", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status]),
      IN("รอชำระ", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status])
    )
  ), "Partially Paid",
  TRUE, "Not Paid"
)

columns.name: Todays Collection Charges
columns.formula: =SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], OR(AND([Payment Status] <> "ชำระแล้ว", [Charge Date] <= TODAY()), AND([Payment Status] = "ชำระแล้ว", [Payment Date] = TODAY()), IN(TODAY(), [Related Repayments][Payment Date]))))

columns.name: Todays Amount Due
columns.formula: =SUM(SELECT([Todays Collection Charges][Amount Due], [Charge Date] <= TODAY()))
columns.display: ="ยอดที่ต้องชำระวันนี้ / Todays Amount Due"

columns.name: Todays Amount Collected
columns.formula: =SUM([Todays Collection Charges][Payment Received Today])
columns.display: ="ยอดที่เก็บได้วันนี้ / Todays Amount Collected"

columns.name: Todays Amount Remaining
columns.formula: =SUM(SELECT([Todays Collection Charges][Amount Remaining], [Charge Date] <= TODAY()))
columns.display: ="ยอดคงเหลือวันนี้ / Todays Amount Remaining"

columns.formula:

  "Overdue",

Oldest Active Loan Age
Overdue Amount
Overdue Charge Count
Historical Charge Count
columns.formula: =COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY())))

columns.name: Recent 30D Charge Count

columns.name: Recent 30D On Time Count
columns.formula: =COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 30, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Historical On Time] = TRUE)))

columns.name: Recent 30D On Time Rate
columns.formula: =IF([Recent 30D Charge Count] = 0, 0, [Recent 30D On Time Count] / [Recent 30D Charge Count])

columns.name: Lifetime Late Payment Count
columns.formula: =COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Historical Late] = TRUE)))

columns.name: Recent 30D Late Payment Count
columns.formula: =COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 30, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Historical Late] = TRUE)))

columns.name: Maximum Days Late
columns.formula: =MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], [Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID]))

columns.name: Last Late Payment Date
columns.formula: =MAX(SELECT(Charges[Charge Date], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Days Late] > 0)))

columns.name: Largest Successful Loan
columns.formula: =MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Loans[Principal Amount], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Loan Status] = "ปิดยอดแล้ว", [Defaulted] = FALSE)))

columns.name: Average Successful Loan Size

columns.name: Projected Monthly Profit Contribution
columns.formula: =SUM(SELECT(Repayments[Interest Paid], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], MONTH([Payment Date]) = MONTH(TODAY()), YEAR([Payment Date]) = YEAR(TODAY())))) + SUM(SELECT(Charges[Interest Remaining], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] <= TODAY()))) + SUM(SELECT(Loans[Expected Interest This Month], [Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID]))
columns.display: ="ส่วนแบ่งกำไรคาดการณ์สิ้นเดือน / Projected Monthly Profit Contribution"

columns.name: Matrix Active Borrower Count

columns.name: Matrix Equal Share Benchmark
columns.formula: =IF([Matrix Active Borrower Count] > 0, 1 / [Matrix Active Borrower Count], "")

columns.name: Matrix Economic Contribution
columns.formula:
=IF(
  SUM(SELECT(Borrowers[Profit Last 10 Days], [Has Active Loan] = TRUE)) > 0,
  [Profit Last 10 Days]
    / SUM(SELECT(Borrowers[Profit Last 10 Days], [Has Active Loan] = TRUE)),
  ""
)

columns.name: Matrix Recent Reliability Score
columns.formula: =IF([Recent 30D Charge Count] = 0, "", 100 * [Recent 30D On Time Count] / [Recent 30D Charge Count])

columns.name: Matrix Historical Reliability Score
columns.formula: =IF(COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 180, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) = 0, "", 100 * COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 180, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Historical On Time] = TRUE))) / COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 180, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))))

columns.name: Matrix Delay Severity Score
columns.formula: =IF(COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) = 0, "", IFS(COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Ref Loans].[Defaulted] = TRUE))) > 0, 0, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) = 0, 100, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) <= 1, 90, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) <= 3, 70, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) <= 7, 40, TRUE, 10))

columns.name: Matrix Current Condition Score
columns.formula: =IFS(COUNT(SELECT(Loans[Row ID], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Defaulted] = TRUE, [Outstanding Principal] > 0))) > 0, 0, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Days Late] > 3))) > 0, 20, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Days Late] >= 2))) > 0, 40, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Days Late] >= 1))) > 0, 60, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] = TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Total Paid] > 0))) > 0, 75, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] = TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0))) > 0, 90, TRUE, 100)

columns.name: Matrix History Sufficient
Matrix Stability Score
columns.formula:
=ROUND(
  10
    * (
    IF(
      ISNOTBLANK([Matrix Recent Reliability Score]),
      [Matrix Recent Reliability Score] * 0.45,
      0
    )
      + IF(
        ISNOTBLANK([Matrix Historical Reliability Score]),
        [Matrix Historical Reliability Score] * 0.20,
        0
      )
      + IF(
        ISNOTBLANK([Matrix Delay Severity Score]),
        [Matrix Delay Severity Score] * 0.20,
        0
      )
      + [Matrix Current Condition Score] * 0.15
    )
    / (
    IF(ISNOTBLANK([Matrix Recent Reliability Score]), 0.45, 0)
      + IF(ISNOTBLANK([Matrix Historical Reliability Score]), 0.20, 0)
      + IF(ISNOTBLANK([Matrix Delay Severity Score]), 0.20, 0)
      + 0.15
    )
)
/ 10

columns.name: Matrix Quadrant
columns.formula:
=IFS(
  [Has Active Loan] = FALSE,
  "",
  OR(
    ISBLANK([Matrix Economic Contribution]),
    ISBLANK([Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution])
  ),
  "Unclassified",
  [Matrix History Sufficient] = FALSE,
  "Provisional - insufficient history",
  AND(
    [Matrix Economic Contribution] >= [Matrix Equal Share Benchmark],
    [Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution] >= 0.5
  ),
  "Star",
  AND(
    [Matrix Economic Contribution] < [Matrix Equal Share Benchmark],
    [Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution] >= 0.5
  ),
  "Cash Cow",
  AND(
    [Matrix Economic Contribution] >= [Matrix Equal Share Benchmark],
    [Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution] < 0.5
  ),
  "Question Mark",
  TRUE,
  "Dog"
)

columns.name: Matrix Bubble Label
columns.formula: =CONCATENATE([Description], " - " , [Matrix Quadrant])

columns.formula:

      [Interest Paid] > 0
    )
  )
)

columns.name: Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution
columns.formula: =MIN(LIST(DECIMAL(1), (DECIMAL([Matrix Economic Contribution]) * [Matrix Active Borrower Count]) / 2))
